beforeImage.name: GS Power Partners
beforeImage.description: Green Street Power Partners, now branded as GS Power Partners, develops, finances, owns, and operates distributed-generation and community-solar projects in the United States. Its customers include utilities, municipalities, commercial users, and community-solar subscribers that rely on contracted distributed renewable generation. The platform is asset-heavy because it develops and owns physical solar assets rather than operating solely as a services or brokerage business. Company materials identify a Northeast and Midwest focus and describe the business as an independent power producer with a sizable operating and development portfolio. DIF announced in 2023 that it had agreed to acquire a majority equity interest in the company through DIF Infrastructure VII, while public sources do not disclose the final ownership percentage.

afterImage.name: GS Power Partners
afterImage.description: GS Power Partners, legally Green Street Power Partners, LLC, develops, finances, owns and operates distributed-generation commercial, industrial and community-solar assets in the United States. The platform adopted the GS Power Partners brand on December 9, 2024 while retaining its legal identity. CVC DIF holds a majority equity interest through DIF Infrastructure VII; the investment closed in April 2023, while the exact percentage and closing day were not publicly disclosed. Current CVC DIF materials continue to list the company as an infrastructure investment, and no later platform sale, transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026. The company is based in Stamford, Connecticut and reported more than 400 MW across more than 125 projects in August 2026.
